meta.title: Beam — Free Screen Recorder & Video Editor
meta.description: Beam is a free, open-source screen recorder and video editor for polished product demos on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

home.lede: Beam makes polished screen recordings, so your product demos are easier to create—and better to watch.
home.demoAlt: Beam video editor showing a product recording
home.showcaseAlt: Beam recorder and video editor shown side by side
home.availabilityPlatforms: Available for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
home.editorText: Trim the noise, refine the pacing, add smooth zooms and captions, then export a polished product demo.
home.freeText: Beam is a free, open-source alternative to paid screen recording tools—built for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
home.openSourceText: Beam is shaped by the people who use it. Follow development on GitHub, contribute to the project, or join the community on Discord.
home.contributorsFallback: Built by the Beam community—and growing.
home.contributors: Built by {count} contributor—and growing. | Built by {count} contributors—and growing.
home.footer: Free, open-source screen recorder and video editor.
